description: This file defines the 'AlwaysSelectedCollectionView' class, a sealed class implementing ICollectionView for use in a Windows UI XAML application. It provides collection view functionalities with some methods not implemented, and includes a converter class for binding purposes.

classes.name: AlwaysSelectedCollectionView
classes.description: A sealed class implementing ICollectionView for collection binding in XAML, wrapping a IBindableVector source and providing current item management.

classes.name: AlwaysSelectedCollectionViewConverter
classes.description: A value converter class for converting IBindableVector to AlwaysSelectedCollectionView in XAML bindings.

methods.name: AlwaysSelectedCollectionView
methods.description: Constructor initializing the collection view with a source IBindableVector and setting up event handling.

methods.name: MoveCurrentTo
methods.description: Implements moving current item to a specific object within the collection.

methods.name: MoveCurrentToPosition
methods.description: Implements moving current item to a specific index within the collection.

methods.name: CurrentItem
methods.description: Property returning the current item based on current position.

methods.name: CurrentPosition
methods.description: Property returning the current index position.

methods.name: IsCurrentAfterLast
methods.description: Property indicating if the current position is after the last item.

methods.name: IsCurrentBeforeFirst
methods.description: Property indicating if the current position is before the first item.

methods.name: OnSourceBindableVectorChanged
methods.description: Event handler updating the collection view when the source vector changes.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts an IBindableVector to an AlwaysSelectedCollectionView.

methods.name: ConvertBack
methods.description: Returns UnsetValue; not implemented for reverse conversion.
